ÇYD · 6th Grade · Theme 1 · School Life

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece's school has a male leader. He is in charge of the whole school and manages its daily work. He is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) headmaster

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece's school has a male leader. He is in charge of the whole school and manages its daily work.” Bu tarif “headmaster” kelimesine uyar; headmaster = müdür. Diğer şıklar: librarian (kütüphane görevlisi), opponent (rakip), finalist (finalist).

2

Selin feels worried about school and needs guidance. A staff member listens and helps her discuss her feelings and choices. This person is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) counsellor

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin feels worried about school and needs guidance. A staff member listens and helps her discuss her feelings and choices.” Bu tarif “counsellor” kelimesine uyar; counsellor = rehber öğretmen. Diğer şıklar: referee (hakem), proposer (öneri sunan kişi), headmistress (müdire).

3

Duru watches a school match from the seats. She does not play or control the game. She is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) spectator

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru watches a school match from the seats. She does not play or control the game.” Bu tarif “spectator” kelimesine uyar; spectator = seyirci. Diğer şıklar: participant (katılımcı), librarian (kütüphane görevlisi), headmaster (müdür).

4

Elif plays chess against another student. Both players want to win the same game. The other student is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) opponent

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif plays chess against another student. Both players want to win the same game.” Bu tarif “opponent” kelimesine uyar; opponent = rakip. Diğer şıklar: headmistress (müdire), referee (hakem), counsellor (rehber öğretmen).

5

Nehir reaches the last round of a contest. She now competes for the top prize in the final. She is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) finalist

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir reaches the last round of a contest. She now competes for the top prize in the final.” Bu tarif “finalist” kelimesine uyar; finalist = finalist. Diğer şıklar: participant (katılımcı), proposer (öneri sunan kişi), spectator (seyirci).

6

Sena follows the school rules. She does what the rules tell students to do. She chooses to ______ them.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) obey

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena follows the school rules. She does what the rules tell students to do.” Bu tarif “obey” kelimesine uyar; obey = uymak. Diğer şıklar: prioritise (öncelik vermek), overcome (üstesinden gelmek), shoot a video (video çekmek).

7

İpek's lesson starts at nine. She reaches the classroom at nine, exactly when it begins. She tries to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) arrive on time

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek's lesson starts at nine. She reaches the classroom at nine, exactly when it begins.” Bu tarif “arrive on time” kelimesine uyar; arrive on time = zamanında gelmek. Diğer şıklar: cancel (iptal etmek), respect (saygı duymak), follow instructions (talimatlara uymak).

8

Eylül's desk is messy after an art task. She puts the pens and papers in their proper places. She decides to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) tidy up

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül's desk is messy after an art task. She puts the pens and papers in their proper places.” Bu tarif “tidy up” kelimesine uyar; tidy up = toparlamak. Diğer şıklar: take notes (not almak), encourage (cesaretlendirmek), prioritise (öncelik vermek).

9

Cemre wants to enter a school tournament. She completes the official process of adding her name to the list. This process is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) registration

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre wants to enter a school tournament. She completes the official process of adding her name to the list.” Bu tarif “registration” kelimesine uyar; registration = kayıt. Diğer şıklar: defeat (yenilgi), tournament (turnuva), reward (ödül).

10

Melis enters an event in which students try to get the best result. An official chooses a winner and gives a prize. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) competition

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis enters an event in which students try to get the best result. An official chooses a winner and gives a prize.” Bu tarif “competition” kelimesine uyar; competition = yarışma. Diğer şıklar: food festival (yemek festivali), anniversary (yıl dönümü), accessibility (erişilebilirlik).

11

Sıla's class discusses a topic in two opposing teams. Each side gives reasons for its opinion and answers the other side. They hold a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) debate

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla's class discusses a topic in two opposing teams. Each side gives reasons for its opinion and answers the other side.” Bu tarif “debate” kelimesine uyar; debate = münazara. Diğer şıklar: diversity (çeşitlilik), innovation (yenilik), mission (görev).

12

Defne's team wins the final match. They celebrate their success over the other team. They celebrate their ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) victory

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne's team wins the final match. They celebrate their success over the other team.” Bu tarif “victory” kelimesine uyar; victory = zafer. Diğer şıklar: religious day (dini gün), outdoor science experiment (açık hava bilim deneyi), art workshop (sanat atölyesi).

13

Buse tries to follow a path, but a large fallen tree blocks it. The tree prevents her from moving forward easily. It is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) obstacle

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse tries to follow a path, but a large fallen tree blocks it. The tree prevents her from moving forward easily.” Bu tarif “obstacle” kelimesine uyar; obstacle = engel. Diğer şıklar: infrastructure (altyapı), rehearsal (prova), diversity (çeşitlilik).

14

İdil knows that her school's opening date is 10 May. Every 10 May, students mark the date of its opening. They celebrate its ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) anniversary

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil knows that her school's opening date is 10 May. Every 10 May, students mark the date of its opening.” Bu tarif “anniversary” kelimesine uyar; anniversary = yıl dönümü. Diğer şıklar: victory (zafer), religious day (dini gün), competition (yarışma).

15

Zeynep visits an event with many stalls selling different dishes. Visitors taste local meals and learn about cooking traditions. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) food festival

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep visits an event with many stalls selling different dishes. Visitors taste local meals and learn about cooking traditions.” Bu tarif “food festival” kelimesine uyar; food festival = yemek festivali. Diğer şıklar: tournament (turnuva), mission (görev), rehearsal (prova).

16

Mina's class tests how sunlight changes the temperature of water. They do their scientific test in the school garden. It is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) outdoor science experiment

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina's class tests how sunlight changes the temperature of water. They do their scientific test in the school garden.” Bu tarif “outdoor science experiment” kelimesine uyar; outdoor science experiment = açık hava bilim deneyi. Diğer şıklar: defeat (yenilgi), art workshop (sanat atölyesi), obstacle (engel).

17

Pelin studies the basic systems that keep her school running. These include buildings, water pipes and electricity networks. Together, they form the school's ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) infrastructure

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin studies the basic systems that keep her school running. These include buildings, water pipes and electricity networks.” Bu tarif “infrastructure” kelimesine uyar; infrastructure = altyapı. Diğer şıklar: reward (ödül), debate (münazara), accessibility (erişilebilirlik).

18

Derya's team creates a new way to save water at school. Their original idea improves how things work. This new approach is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) innovation

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya's team creates a new way to save water at school. Their original idea improves how things work.” Bu tarif “innovation” kelimesine uyar; innovation = yenilik. Diğer şıklar: registration (kayıt), religious day (dini gün), tournament (turnuva).

19

Sena's friend feels unsure about joining a contest. Sena gives her confidence with kind words and tells her to try. She wants to ______ her friend.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) encourage

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena's friend feels unsure about joining a contest. Sena gives her confidence with kind words and tells her to try.” Bu tarif “encourage” kelimesine uyar; encourage = cesaretlendirmek. Diğer şıklar: take notes (not almak), shoot a video (video çekmek), tidy up (toparlamak).

20

Eda sees colourful decorations and lights at a celebration. Music and happy visitors create a holiday atmosphere. The place looks ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) festive

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda sees colourful decorations and lights at a celebration. Music and happy visitors create a holiday atmosphere.” Bu tarif “festive” kelimesine uyar; festive = şenlikli. Diğer şıklar: engaging (ilgi çekici), amusing (eğlenceli), charming (çekici, sevimli).

21

Cem feels extremely unhappy after a difficult day. He has no energy to smile or enjoy anything. He feels ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) miserable

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem feels extremely unhappy after a difficult day. He has no energy to smile or enjoy anything.” Bu tarif “miserable” kelimesine uyar; miserable = perişan, kötü. Diğer şıklar: offensive (saldırgan, kırıcı), motivating (motive edici), enjoyable (keyifli).

22

Eren strongly wants to win every contest. He enjoys trying to do better than other players. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) competitive

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren strongly wants to win every contest. He enjoys trying to do better than other players.” Bu tarif “competitive” kelimesine uyar; competitive = rekabetçi. Diğer şıklar: opposing (karşıt), inspiring (ilham verici), rewarding (ödüllendirici).

23

Baran plans an event, but the school cannot hold it safely. He decides that it must not take place. He needs to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) cancel

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran plans an event, but the school cannot hold it safely. He decides that it must not take place.” Bu tarif “cancel” kelimesine uyar; cancel = iptal etmek. Diğer şıklar: follow instructions (talimatlara uymak), arrive on time (zamanında gelmek), overcome (üstesinden gelmek).

24

Tolga helps whenever his friend asks him. He does this every single time without exception. He ______ helps his friend.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) always

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga helps whenever his friend asks him. He does this every single time without exception.” Bu tarif “always” kelimesine uyar; always = her zaman. Diğer şıklar: rarely (nadiren), never (asla, hiç), often (sık sık).

25

Ozan practises basketball on Mondays and Thursdays only. These are his two practice sessions each week. He practises ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) twice a week

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan practises basketball on Mondays and Thursdays only. These are his two practice sessions each week.” Bu tarif “twice a week” kelimesine uyar; twice a week = haftada iki kez. Diğer şıklar: once a day (günde bir kez), twice a day (günde iki kez), twice a month (ayda iki kez).

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Mert visits the woman who leads his school. She manages the school and meets the teachers regularly. She is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) headmistress

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert visits the woman who leads his school. She manages the school and meets the teachers regularly.” Bu tarif “headmistress” kelimesine uyar; headmistress = müdire. Diğer şıklar: opponent (rakip), finalist (finalist), spectator (seyirci).

2

Bora wants help finding a book. A worker looks after the books and helps students borrow them. This person is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) librarian

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora wants help finding a book. A worker looks after the books and helps students borrow them.” Bu tarif “librarian” kelimesine uyar; librarian = kütüphane görevlisi. Diğer şıklar: counsellor (rehber öğretmen), proposer (öneri sunan kişi), headmaster (müdür).

3

Arda watches a person with a whistle during a match. This person checks that players follow the rules and makes decisions. The person is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) referee

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda watches a person with a whistle during a match. This person checks that players follow the rules and makes decisions.” Bu tarif “referee” kelimesine uyar; referee = hakem. Diğer şıklar: headmistress (müdire), opponent (rakip), spectator (seyirci).

4

Can takes part in the school's art event. He joins the activity instead of only watching it. He is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) participant

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can takes part in the school's art event. He joins the activity instead of only watching it.” Bu tarif “participant” kelimesine uyar; participant = katılımcı. Diğer şıklar: librarian (kütüphane görevlisi), headmaster (müdür), finalist (finalist).

5

Emir suggests a new plan for the school garden. He is the person who puts the idea forward for discussion. He is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) proposer

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir suggests a new plan for the school garden. He is the person who puts the idea forward for discussion.” Bu tarif “proposer” kelimesine uyar; proposer = öneri sunan kişi. Diğer şıklar: counsellor (rehber öğretmen), referee (hakem), opponent (rakip).

6

Baran values other people's opinions. He listens politely and treats people with consideration. He tries to ______ others.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) respect

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran values other people's opinions. He listens politely and treats people with consideration.” Bu tarif “respect” kelimesine uyar; respect = saygı duymak. Diğer şıklar: cancel (iptal etmek), obey (uymak), overcome (üstesinden gelmek).

7

Tolga reads the teacher's steps before a task. He does each step in the order the teacher explains. He needs to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) follow instructions

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga reads the teacher's steps before a task. He does each step in the order the teacher explains.” Bu tarif “follow instructions” kelimesine uyar; follow instructions = talimatlara uymak. Diğer şıklar: tidy up (toparlamak), encourage (cesaretlendirmek), arrive on time (zamanında gelmek).

8

Ozan listens to an important talk. He writes short reminders of the main ideas in his notebook. He likes to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) take notes

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan listens to an important talk. He writes short reminders of the main ideas in his notebook.” Bu tarif “take notes” kelimesine uyar; take notes = not almak. Diğer şıklar: shoot a video (video çekmek), prioritise (öncelik vermek), overcome (üstesinden gelmek).

9

Yusuf's class prepares a play. They practise the whole performance before the real show. They have a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) rehearsal

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf's class prepares a play. They practise the whole performance before the real show.” Bu tarif “rehearsal” kelimesine uyar; rehearsal = prova. Diğer şıklar: registration (kayıt), defeat (yenilgi), victory (zafer).

10

Aras enters a chess event with many rounds. Players compete in a series of matches until one person wins the whole event. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) tournament

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras enters a chess event with many rounds. Players compete in a series of matches until one person wins the whole event.” Bu tarif “tournament” kelimesine uyar; tournament = turnuva. Diğer şıklar: accessibility (erişilebilirlik), diversity (çeşitlilik), innovation (yenilik).

11

Gökçe's team receives an important job. They need to find ways to make the school garden safer. This is their ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) mission

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe's team receives an important job. They need to find ways to make the school garden safer.” Bu tarif “mission” kelimesine uyar; mission = görev. Diğer şıklar: obstacle (engel), religious day (dini gün), infrastructure (altyapı).

12

Kerem's team loses the match. The other team wins, so his side experiences a loss. This result is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) defeat

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem's team loses the match. The other team wins, so his side experiences a loss.” Bu tarif “defeat” kelimesine uyar; defeat = yenilgi. Diğer şıklar: anniversary (yıl dönümü), competition (yarışma), debate (münazara).

13

Deniz works hard on a school project. His teacher gives him a special prize for his effort. He receives a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) reward

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz works hard on a school project. His teacher gives him a special prize for his effort.” Bu tarif “reward” kelimesine uyar; reward = ödül. Diğer şıklar: food festival (yemek festivali), outdoor science experiment (açık hava bilim deneyi), rehearsal (prova).

14

Onur's family celebrates a day connected with their faith. The occasion is about their religion rather than a national event. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) religious day

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur's family celebrates a day connected with their faith. The occasion is about their religion rather than a national event.” Bu tarif “religious day” kelimesine uyar; religious day = dini gün. Diğer şıklar: competition (yarışma), diversity (çeşitlilik), registration (kayıt).

15

Arda joins a practical session with paints and clay. An artist guides students as they make their own pictures and models. It is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) art workshop

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda joins a practical session with paints and clay. An artist guides students as they make their own pictures and models.” Bu tarif “art workshop” kelimesine uyar; art workshop = sanat atölyesi. Diğer şıklar: anniversary (yıl dönümü), infrastructure (altyapı), mission (görev).

16

Ali's school wants everyone to enter and use its spaces easily. Ramps and wide doors help people with different physical needs. The ease of access is called ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) accessibility

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali's school wants everyone to enter and use its spaces easily. Ramps and wide doors help people with different physical needs.” Bu tarif “accessibility” kelimesine uyar; accessibility = erişilebilirlik. Diğer şıklar: reward (ödül), tournament (turnuva), food festival (yemek festivali).

17

Efe's class includes students with different languages, backgrounds and abilities. These differences make the group varied. The class values this ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) diversity

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe's class includes students with different languages, backgrounds and abilities. These differences make the group varied.” Bu tarif “diversity” kelimesine uyar; diversity = çeşitlilik. Diğer şıklar: innovation (yenilik), victory (zafer), art workshop (sanat atölyesi).

18

Berk has several tasks to complete. He decides which tasks are most important and deals with those first. He needs to ______ them.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) prioritise

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk has several tasks to complete. He decides which tasks are most important and deals with those first.” Bu tarif “prioritise” kelimesine uyar; prioritise = öncelik vermek. Diğer şıklar: shoot a video (video çekmek), arrive on time (zamanında gelmek), tidy up (toparlamak).

19

Burak faces a difficult problem with his project. He works hard and successfully deals with the difficulty. He manages to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) overcome

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak faces a difficult problem with his project. He works hard and successfully deals with the difficulty.” Bu tarif “overcome” kelimesine uyar; overcome = üstesinden gelmek. Diğer şıklar: take notes (not almak), follow instructions (talimatlara uymak), cancel (iptal etmek).

20

Tuna watches a short play full of jokes. Its funny moments make the audience laugh. The play is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) amusing

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna watches a short play full of jokes. Its funny moments make the audience laugh.” Bu tarif “amusing” kelimesine uyar; amusing = eğlenceli. Diğer şıklar: competitive (rekabetçi), charming (çekici, sevimli), opposing (karşıt).

21

Aylin hears a comment that is rude and insulting. It hurts another person's feelings. The comment is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) offensive

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aylin hears a comment that is rude and insulting. It hurts another person's feelings.” Bu tarif “offensive” kelimesine uyar; offensive = saldırgan, kırıcı. Diğer şıklar: motivating (motive edici), miserable (perişan, kötü), enjoyable (keyifli).

22

Nehir volunteers to help younger students. The work takes effort, but helping them makes her feel satisfied and proud. She finds it ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) rewarding

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir volunteers to help younger students. The work takes effort, but helping them makes her feel satisfied and proud.” Bu tarif “rewarding” kelimesine uyar; rewarding = ödüllendirici. Diğer şıklar: festive (şenlikli), competitive (rekabetçi), opposing (karşıt).

23

İpek uses her phone camera during a school event. She records moving images rather than taking only a photograph. She wants to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) shoot a video

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek uses her phone camera during a school event. She records moving images rather than taking only a photograph.” Bu tarif “shoot a video” kelimesine uyar; shoot a video = video çekmek. Diğer şıklar: obey (uymak), respect (saygı duymak), encourage (cesaretlendirmek).

24

Eylül follows the library rules. She does not eat inside the library on any occasion. She ______ eats there.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) never

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül follows the library rules. She does not eat inside the library on any occasion.” Bu tarif “never” kelimesine uyar; never = asla, hiç. Diğer şıklar: rarely (nadiren), usually (genellikle), always (her zaman).

25

Cemre's school holds its founding-day celebration on one date each year. It has no second celebration of this event that year. The event takes place ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) once a year

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre's school holds its founding-day celebration on one date each year. It has no second celebration of this event that year.” Bu tarif “once a year” kelimesine uyar; once a year = yılda bir kez. Diğer şıklar: twice a month (ayda iki kez), once a week (haftada bir kez), twice a week (haftada iki kez).

3Vocabulary Quiz 50 · Choose the correct Turkish meaning of each word. (Her kelimenin doğru Türkçe anlamını seçiniz.)

1

headmaster

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) müdür

“headmaster” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “müdür” olur. Bu ifade “Okuldaki insanlar” grubundandır. Örnek: The headmaster opened the school ceremony.

2

headmistress

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) müdire

“headmistress” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “müdire” olur. Bu ifade “Okuldaki insanlar” grubundandır. Örnek: The headmistress talked to the parents.

3

counsellor

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) rehber öğretmen

“counsellor” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “rehber öğretmen” olur. Bu ifade “Okuldaki insanlar” grubundandır. Örnek: I talk to the school counsellor about my problems.

4

librarian

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) kütüphane görevlisi

“librarian” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “kütüphane görevlisi” olur. Bu ifade “Okuldaki insanlar” grubundandır. Örnek: The librarian helped me find a book.

5
